interaction.prompt: The puck is back with their defense and their forwards are flat-footed. Tap the ice you should step up to so you take away their time and space.

mc.stem: The puck is back with their defenseman and their forwards are flat-footed. You are the defenseman. What is your read?
opts: Step up under control to tighten the gap and take away open ice
Keep backing in even though the forwards have no speed
Pinch hard and gamble on the puck before they have even moved
Stay stationary and wait for the forwards to skate into you

feedback.right: Yes. When the attack slows down, take the ice back. Stepping up under control closes the gap before they rebuild speed.
feedback.wrong: Backing in or drifting gives flat-footed forwards time to rebuild speed. Step up under control and take the ice away.

tip: When the attack has no speed, step up and take ice back to kill their time and space.
why: When the attack slows, the defender can take ice back. Stepping up under control closes the gap before the forwards rebuild speed.
